blocks.html: For the purposes of applying the special bulk regulations of Section 139-212 (Gowanus mix), Gowanus mix uses shall include referenced commercial and manufacturing uses, as well as libraries, museums, community centers, non-commercial art galleries and philanthropic or non-profit institutions without sleeping accommodations listed under Use Group III. However, automotive repair and maintenance establishments listed under Use Group VI shall not be included.
